recipe.name: Espresso Martini
directions: Shake all of the ingredients with ice until chilled, then strain into a chilled glass, and garnish.

Options
Bitter Orange and VanillaUse Amaro Nonino for the amaro, and garnish with an orange twist.
Alpine and ChamomileUse Braulio for the amaro, and garnish with espresso beans.
Mint and ChocolateUse Branca Menta for the amaro, and garnish with a mint leaf.
Herbs and CaramelUse Cynar for the amaro, and garnish with espresso beans.
